difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a homomorphism between the two Artin-Schreier like quotients of polynomial rings the trace computed using the source generator equals the trace computed using the target generator composed with the homomorphism (statement lines 399-403). The proof (proof lines 405-498) reduces to the universal case by introducing the universal coefficient ring, and then verifies the required coefficient identities in two cases, using that the expressions are derivatives and, in the remaining case, the vanishing of the intermediate binomial coefficients modulo p. H3: a long explicit computation with a universal reduction, written out in full.
